# Algorithm & Data Literacy Project

> A UNESCO-supported initiative by Digital2030 and partners to build public understanding of algorithms, artificial intelligence, and data literacy through educational resources and workshops.

The Algorithm & Data Literacy Project (also known as Projet Décode in French) provides comprehensive educational materials and guides for understanding how algorithms and AI systems work, with a focus on responsible AI, ethics, and practical literacy for diverse audiences including students and educators.

## Key Topics

- Algorithm Literacy
- Data Literacy
- Artificial Intelligence
- Trustworthy AI
- Responsible AI
- Machine Learning
- Ethics
- Educational Resources
- Workshops
- Algorithmes
- Intelligence Artificielle
- Littératie des données
- UNESCO
- Digital2030
- Projet Décode
